_comment: Checkpoints (docs/plan-longer-levels.md; src/world/triggers/checkpoint.gd). A level entity {type: checkpoint, x, y}: the tile is the cell Kaya stands in, her feet on the tile below, exactly like player_spawn. The post is two tiles tall and is drawn standing on that floor.
_trigger: Kaya lights it by overlapping the post: the cell and the one above it, grown by touch_grow_px. The prover (tools/solver/sim.gd) and tools/levelstats read the same rectangle through Checkpoint.trigger_rect(), so 'the route passes this checkpoint' means what lights it in play.
_respawn: After a death with lives left, Kaya comes back on the active checkpoint with full hearts, in the form she touched it in, and invulnerable for respawn_invuln_s: enemies reset to their spawns on a respawn, and one standing on the post must not be able to take a heart before she has seen it. The same blink as a hit (Player.INVULN_TIME is 1.1).
_look: Sheet frames, left to right: unlit, then the lit flame's flicker cycle at flame_fps.
_glow: The additive light a lit post throws, drawn under the post with the ambience light-pool texture, so it reads in the dark worlds (deeps' shade is 0.8+): glow_radius_px world units, glow_colour RGBA, breathing by glow_pulse of its alpha at glow_pulse_hz. An unlit post throws a faint one, unlit_glow_alpha of it, so a checkpoint can be found in the dark before it is lit. glow_lift_px raises the pool's centre to the brazier.
_feedback: On lighting: the checkpoint sound, the checkpoint particle burst (data/fx.json) at the brazier, and a HUD flash for flash_s.
